title: Angry Karen Chases Down 14-Year-Old On Bike
description:
Deputies in Flagler County, Florida, confronted a woman, later identified as 65-year-old Julia Kalthof, dubbed the "neighborhood Karen," who was caught on multiple cell phone videos allegedly chasing a 14-year-old boy riding an e-bike on a sidewalk with her car. After the victim and his family pressed charges, deputies located and confronted Kalthof, leading to her arrest for aggravated assault with a deadly weapon and reckless driving.
